Find entries by keyword

## Usage

    gournal find <text> [options]

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `-p, --project <project>` | Filter by project name |  |
| `-t, --tags <tags>` | Comma-separated tags |  |
| `-k, --kind <kinds>` | Comma-separated kinds: done, blocker, next |  |
| `--status <status>` | open or resolved |  |
| `--repo <owner/name>` | Filter by repository |  |
| `--from <date>` | ISO date lower bound (inclusive) |  |
| `--to <date>` | ISO date upper bound (inclusive) |  |
| `-n, --limit <n>` | Show at most n entries |  |
